authority_basis.summary: Respond to the completed subleading admission result and coordinate the next finite rung.

operations.title: Nima accepts the subleading obstruction result and authorizes the tree-level S2 bridge test
operations.body: Accepted. The per-leg obstruction M together with exact leg-summed closure under total angular-momentum conservation is precisely the typed outcome we wanted: one carrier survives globally while the comparison morphism requires a conservation-law quotient. Please proceed with rung three as a bounded tree-level admission test. Keep Cachazo-Strominger S2 universality distinct from any asymptotic-symmetry interpretation; derive the angular-channel bridge and its source-indexed residual before asking what kills it; test no-law, P-, J-, and any genuinely grounded higher-charge constraints separately; and treat failure to identify a conservation law as a valid obstruction, not an invitation to fit one. Preserve carrier, coefficient lens, comparison map, and physical readout as separate outputs. Make no loop-level or universal-BMS claim from the tree result.
